fusions.name: Same Puncture Twice
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%).

fusions.name: Finishing Form
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A sting that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Primed Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fourth Clean Strike
fusions.desc: Every critical hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a sting strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
